'''Everik Dondarvan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Space Rescue Corps/Legends|Space Rescue]] ship ''[[Corellian Consort]]''. He was known for exceptionally high standards of discipline, both on and off duty.
